name: Hamburger icon
looksLike: three horizontal lines stacked in a button
the icon you tap to open the menu on a phone
definition: An icon of three stacked horizontal lines that opens a hidden navigation menu. It is the standard toggle for mobile menus and drawers.

prompts.short: Add a hamburger button that opens the mobile menu.
prompts.detailed: Add a 44px hamburger icon button (three lines) to the navbar on screens below 768px. Give it an aria-label, aria-expanded, and aria-controls pointing at the menu, and animate it to an X when open.

a11yNotes: Expose the open state with aria-expanded
Keep the tap target at least 44px
